newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein steady steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein steady steady in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were steady in late trading on Monday, with buying interest improving from last week's lull, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,460-70 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening but higher than last Friday's closing level of 1,450-55 rupiah. Crude palm oil was done at 1,271 rupiah/kg in Medan last week.

"Buyers were beginning to take positions today," one trader said. "Good export prices are keeping sentiment upbeat, and I think prices will be hovering around this level tomorrow. There is talk of supply being tight, but it has not been felt yet."
